requirements.text: Transform the black DVD into a white DVD.
requirements.source_phrase: transform the black DVD into a white DVD

outcomes.description: Change the black DVD to white while retaining its identity as a DVD.
outcomes.target: The DVD is visibly white rather than black.
outcomes.reference: The black DVD in the input image.

nodes.question: Was the specific black DVD in the source image transformed into a visibly white DVD in the edited image?
nodes.criteria: Pass only if the source black DVD can be matched to an edited object and that same object is visibly white while remaining identifiable as a DVD. Fail if the source DVD is confidently matched and remains black, or is confidently shown not to have been transformed into a white DVD. Unknown if the source DVD's identity or correspondence to an edited object cannot be established.
nodes.binding: Compare the small rectangular item near the center of the source with both edited white discs. Weigh position, shape, and surrounding scene context together; do not assume either disc is the source DVD based on whiteness or location alone. Judge only whether the requested transformation is established, not whether some unrelated white disc appeared. Reserve unknown for genuinely unresolved source identity or correspondence.

nodes.question: Does the edited object confidently matched to the source item remain identifiable as a DVD?
nodes.criteria: Pass if an object confidently matched to the source item remains identifiable as a DVD. Fail if a confidently matched object is no longer identifiable as a DVD. Unknown if the source item is not established as a DVD or no edited object can confidently be matched to it.
nodes.binding: Assess DVD identity and source-to-edit correspondence only. Compare the source item's position, shape, and scene context with each edited candidate, including both white discs; do not require the DVD to remain independently recognizable by its original appearance, and do not infer identity from whiteness alone. Do not judge whether the requested color change progressed here; reserve unknown for unresolved identity or correspondence.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The source has a small rectangular, apparently black/gray item near the center. In the edited image there are two white discs: one near the center-left and one beside the dark object on the right. The source item’s rectangular appearance and the changed scene make its correspondence to either disc unclear; neither can be confidently identified as the transformed DVD.

The source item near the center appears to be a rectangular DVD case or cover, not a clearly visible DVD disc. The edited image contains two white discs, but neither can be confidently matched to that source item based on position, shape, or scene context.
